title: Masooma ki faryad
body:
Masooma ki faryad
BaBa(a.s.) Kay Liey Qaid Mein Roti Thi Sakina(s.a.)
Yeh Kon Hai Kia Naam Hai Hakim Nay Yeh Poocha
Darbaan Nay Hakim Ko Yeh Tab Jakay Bataya
Eik Bachi Hai Rassi Say Gala Dukhta Hai Jiska
Main Is Juda Karta Hoon Jab Bhai(a.s.) Say Is(s.a.) Kay
Yeh Khauf Zada Hokay Yehi Karti Hai Naalay
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aray Zalimon Sitam Na Karo Labon Par Ruki Meri Jaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Behan(s.a.) Kehti Thi Yeh Sajjad(a.s.) Ki Sifarish Karo Laen Say
MeriYeh Tum(a.s.) Say Mujhay Juda Na Karay Meray Haal Par Mujhay Chorh
DayYahan Tum Raho Wahan Main Rahon To Bas Mot Ka Hi Imkan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Padar(a.s.) Aur Chacha(a.s.) Kay Sar Hain Juda Mera Bhai(a.s.) Bhi
To Mara GayaYeh Beemar(a.s.) Jo Mera Bhai Hai Yahan Is(A.S) Ko Bhi Qaza
Lai HaiJuda Hokay Hum(a.s.) Na Jee Paengay Saza Yeh Na Do To Ehsaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Ujaalon Mein Main(s.a.) Hamaisha Rahi Na Bhai Mujhay Kabhi Teergi
Yeh Tanhaiyan Yeh Tarikiyan Meri Umr Say Barhi Sakhtiyan
Main Zakhmi Badan Main Tashna Dahan Meri Mot Ka Yeh Saamaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Chalo Ab Kabhi Nahin Rouongi Aziyat Mein Hoon Magar Souongi
Chalo Ab Rahogay Tum Chain Say Na Jagoo Gay Tum Meray Bain Say Mujhay Hai Khabar Main(s.a.) Roi Agar To Zulm-o-Sitam Ka Toofaan
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Tamanchay Lagay Main Chup Hi Rahi Gohar Chin Gaey Main Chup Hi
Rahi Giri Oont Say Rah-e-Shaam Mein Tamanchay Milay Hain Inaam Mein
Mujhay Ronay Do Aray Zalimon Mera Dil Bohat Pareshaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai)x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda Kay Liey Sitam Yeh Na Kar Kisi Say Nahin Khuda Say To Dar
Nabi(s.a.w.w.) Ka Agar Tu Hai Ummati Yeh Be Hurmati Sar-e-Shaah Ki
Kudara Na Kar Aray Bad Nazar Yeh Sar Deen Hai Yeh Quraan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Mujhay Hai Khabar Na Jee Paaongi Yahan Say Na Ab Main Ghar Jaaongi
Karay Ga Na Ab Koi Bhi Madad Isi Qaid Main Banaygi Lahad
Mera Perahan Banayga Kafan Keh Maskan Mera Yeh Zindaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai Jaari Lahoo Meray Kaan Say Yeh Kaisa Sitam Hai Mehmaan Say
Phophi(s.a.) Say Alag Hoon Maan Say Juda Hai Kurta Mera Lahoo Say Bhara
Meri Zindagi Dukhon Say Bhari Yeh Mazloomiat Meri Shaan Hai
<<MINI>>
(Juda Naa Karo Mujhay Bhai(a.s.) Say Andhera Bohat Yeh Zindan Hai) x2
